name: Slowed
subtitle: Slowed + Reverb music player for iPhone
description: Official source for Slowed, a free and open-source iPhone music player with one-tap Slowed + Reverb, nightcore, a 10-band EQ, synced lyrics and hi-res FLAC playback.

apps.name: Slowed
apps.subtitle: Slowed + Reverb, EQ, synced lyrics & hi-res FLAC
apps.localizedDescription:
Turn any song into slowed + reverb or nightcore with one tap, and play your own music library offline.

• Slowed + Reverb: 0.5x–1.5x speed with vinyl-style pitch (or keep pitch), extra pitch, reverb amount and 8 room types. Presets: Slowed, Super slowed, Daycore, Nightcore, Reverb only.
• 10-band equalizer with presets and bass boost, plus 8D audio, echo and underwater effects.
• Apple Music-style Now Playing with artwork colors, AirPlay and the real audio format (e.g. FLAC · 24-bit · 96 kHz).
• Synced lyrics from file tags, .lrc files or LRCLIB.net — tap a line to jump.
• Import MP3, M4A, WAV, AIFF and FLAC from Files; cover art and tags are read automatically.
• Background playback, lock screen controls, export songs with effects.
• Liquid Glass design on iOS 26, 7 languages.

No ads, no account, free and open source (MIT).

permissions.usageDescription: Keeps your music playing in the background and on the lock screen.
